methods.label: Determine signs from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
Work from the inside outward, using \(|u|=-u\) whenever \(u<0\). Since \(x<-2\), we have \(1+x<-1<0\), so
\[
|1+x|=-(1+x)=-1-x.
\]
It follows that
\[
1-|1+x|=1-(-1-x)=2+x.
\]
The condition \(x<-2\) also gives \(2+x<0\). Therefore,
\[
\bigl|1-|1+x|\bigr|=|2+x|=-(2+x)=-2-x.
\]
The answer is \(-2-x\), choice B.
